title: Teaching Claude Why
summary: Anthropic's research on teaching Claude to articulate the reasoning behind its decisions, moving beyond simple outputs to explainable AI reasoning. The article explores Constitutional AI techniques that enable models to self-critique and provide transparent explanations for their choices.
problem_solved: Addresses the 'black box' problem by teaching AI models to explain their reasoning and decision-making process.
why_valuable: Builds trust and enables better human oversight of AI systems by making model reasoning transparent and interpretable.
